admitted.nl: Extend each 8 in a straight line toward the nearest side of the solid 5 rectangle, filling 8s until the rectangle (without overwriting it).
For each 8, project it horizontally or vertically toward the 5 block only when its row/column lies within the block span.
Complete 8-colored rays from each marker toward the bounding rectangle of 5s, stopping at its boundary.
Connect only isolated 8 markers that share a row or column with the 5 object, filling the gap up to the object's bounding box.
The rectangle's four side spans define valid rays; every 8 on an extension of a side is propagated inward along that ray.
